verses.1: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from amongst the children of men.
verses.2: Everyone lies to his neighbour. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
verses.3: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
verses.4: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
verses.5: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
verses.6: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
verses.7: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.8: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted amongst the sons of men.
